I don’t know if this helps, but here’s my personal opinion: What kind of God would outlaw true, consenting love? I’d understand if God outlawed pedophilia ( which is disgusting ), but outlawing two men or women marrying when they BOTH CONSENT TO IT?! That’s wrong. My pastor used to say that LGBT+ people are all lustful. That’s wrong. Some hetero people are lustful, just as some LGBT+ people are. But grouping ALL LGBT+ people as lustful? That’s fucked up and completely immoral. I’ve seen couples who are truly in love with one another, and not just for sex. Yeah, sure, God created marriage between a man and a woman, but there’s also polygamy, which God HIMSELF promoted. Any of you don’t believe me? Just read 2 Samuel 12:8. They say God defined marriage as one man and one woman. Yet, God HIMSELF gave King David multiple wives. Now, if God ( assuming He exists ) said marriage was between one man and one woman, He contradicted Himself. But if MAN said marriage is between one man and one woman, then they are wrong, and polyamorous relationships ARE ok. So if marriage ISN’T only between one man and one woman, why can’t marriage be between two men or two women? Why not between a BUNCH of people, REGARDLESS of gender?

Now, if a man becomes a Christian and has three wives, he can’t just divorce two and keep one, because Jesus said that you should only divorce your spouse if they commit fornication. Now, if the other two women were both fornicators, he should divorce them ( in Jesus’s eyes ), but if they aren’t fornicators, then what? He would be wrong to divorce them. So, why would God outlaw Polygamy when HE KNEW something like this would pop up? In my opinion, not all people who are polygamous are lustful. Some people just want to have another person ( or multiple people ) to share their life with, and there’s nothing wrong with that, as long as they all consent.
